description: List cases (manual-review workflow items grouping inquiries/reports for an analyst to adjudicate). Optionally filter by status, case_template_id, account_id, reference_id, inquiry_id, report_id, and paginate via the JSON:API links.next cursor (page_after) / links.prev (page_before). Returns JSON:API { data:[...], links } — objects contain PII. Persona REST: GET /cases.

account_id.description: Filter by the associated account id.

case_template_id.description: Filter by the case template id.

inquiry_id.description: Filter by an associated inquiry id.

page_after.description: Pagination cursor: return the page AFTER this record id (follow the links.next cursor).

page_before.description: Pagination cursor: return the page BEFORE this record id (follow the links.prev cursor).

page_size.description: Page size — number of records per page.

reference_id.description: Filter by your own reference-id set on the case.

report_id.description: Filter by an associated report id.

status.description: Filter by case status (e.g. open, resolved, waiting).

name: persona_list_cases
title: List cases
